description: This file defines the data model for calculator buttons, including enumerations for operations and actions, and a struct representing individual CalculatorButton instances with convenience factory methods.

classes.name: CalculatorButtonModel
classes.description: Represents a calculator button with properties such as title, type, whether it is wide, and associated operation or action. Provides static factory methods to create buttons for digits, operations, actions, and the equals button.

methods.name: digit
methods.description: Creates a calculator button for a digit given its integer value.

methods.name: operation
methods.description: Creates a calculator button for a specific calculator operation (+, −, ×, ÷).

methods.name: action
methods.description: Creates a calculator button for a specific action (clear, sign, percent, decimal, backspace) with optional parameters for kind and width.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Creates a calculator button representing the equals (=) operation.
